sourceChapterWithLineNumbers:
1:   Krishna.[FN#l6]
2:   Hear farther yet, thou Long-Armed Lord! these latest words I say--
3:   Uttered to bring thee bliss and peace, who lovest Me alway--
4:   Not the great company of gods nor kingly Rishis know
5:   My Nature, Who have made the gods and Rishis long ago;
6:   He only knoweth-only he is free of sin, and wise,
7:   Who seeth Me, Lord of the Worlds, with faith-enlightened eyes,
8:   Unborn, undying, unbegun. Whatever Natures be
9:   To mortal men distributed, those natures spring from Me!
10:   Intellect, skill, enlightenment, endurance, self-control,
11:   Truthfulness, equability, and grief or joy of soul,
12:   And birth and death, and fearfulness, and fearlessness, and shame,
13:   And honour, and sweet harmlessness,[FN#17] and peace which is the
14:   same
15:   Whate'er befalls, and mirth, and tears, and piety, and thrift,
16:   And wish to give, and will to help,--all cometh of My gift!
17:   The Seven Chief Saints, the Elders Four, the Lordly Manus set--
18:   Sharing My work--to rule the worlds, these too did I beget;
19:   And Rishis, Pitris, Manus, all, by one thought of My mind;
20:   Thence did arise, to fill this world, the races of mankind;
21:   Wherefrom who comprehends My Reign of mystic Majesty--
22:   That truth of truths--is thenceforth linked in faultless faith to Me:
23:   Yea! knowing Me the source of all, by Me all creatures wrought,
24:   The wise in spirit cleave to Me, into My Being brought;
25:   Hearts fixed on Me; breaths breathed to Me; praising Me, each to each,
26:   So have they happiness and peace, with pious thought and speech;
27:   And unto these--thus serving well, thus loving ceaselessly--
28:   I give a mind of perfect mood, whereby they draw to Me;
29:   And, all for love of them, within their darkened souls I dwell,
30:   And, with bright rays of wisdom's lamp, their ignorance dispel.
31: 
32:   Arjuna.
33:   Yes! Thou art Parabrahm! The High Abode!
34:   The Great Purification! Thou art God
35:   Eternal, All-creating, Holy, First,
36:   Without beginning! Lord of Lords and Gods!
37:   Declared by all the Saints--by Narada,
38:   Vyasa Asita, and Devalas;
39:   And here Thyself declaring unto me!
40:   What Thou hast said now know I to be truth,
41:   O Kesava! that neither gods nor men
42:   Nor demons comprehend Thy mystery
43:   Made manifest, Divinest! Thou Thyself
44:   Thyself alone dost know, Maker Supreme!
45:   Master of all the living! Lord of Gods!
46:   King of the Universe! To Thee alone
47:   Belongs to tell the heavenly excellence
48:   Of those perfections wherewith Thou dost fill
49:   These worlds of Thine; Pervading, Immanent!
50:   How shall I learn, Supremest Mystery!
51:   To know Thee, though I muse continually?
52:   Under what form of Thine unnumbered forms
53:   Mayst Thou be grasped? Ah! yet again recount,
54:   Clear and complete, Thy great appearances,
55:   The secrets of Thy Majesty and Might,
56:   Thou High Delight of Men! Never enough
57:   Can mine ears drink the Amrit[FN#18] of such words!
58: 
59:   Krishna.
60:   Hanta! So be it! Kuru Prince! I will to thee unfold
61:   Some portions of My Majesty, whose powers are manifold!
62:   I am the Spirit seated deep in every creature's heart;
63:   From Me they come; by Me they live; at My word they depart!
64:   Vishnu of the Adityas I am, those Lords of Light;
65:   Maritchi of the Maruts, the Kings of Storm and Blight;
66:   By day I gleam, the golden Sun of burning cloudless Noon;
67:   By Night, amid the asterisms I glide, the dappled Moon!
68:   Of Vedas I am Sama-Ved, of gods in Indra's Heaven
69:   Vasava; of the faculties to living beings given
70:   The mind which apprehends and thinks; of Rudras Sankara;
71:   Of Yakshas and of Rakshasas, Vittesh; and Pavaka
72:   Of Vasus, and of mountain-peaks Meru; Vrihaspati
73:   Know Me 'mid planetary Powers; 'mid Warriors heavenly
74:   Skanda; of all the water-floods the Sea which drinketh each,
75:   And Bhrigu of the holy Saints, and OM of sacred speech;
76:   Of prayers the prayer ye whisper;[FN#19] of hills Himala's snow,
77:   And Aswattha, the fig-tree, of all the trees that grow;
78:   Of the Devarshis, Narada; and Chitrarath of them
79:   That sing in Heaven, and Kapila of Munis, and the gem
80:   Of flying steeds, Uchchaisravas, from Amrit-wave which burst;
81:   Of elephants Airavata; of males the Best and First;
82:   Of weapons Heav'n's hot thunderbolt; of cows white Kamadhuk,
83:   From whose great milky udder-teats all hearts' desires are strook;
84:   Vasuki of the serpent-tribes, round Mandara entwined;
85:   And thousand-fanged Ananta, on whose broad coils reclined
86:   Leans Vishnu; and of water-things Varuna; Aryam
87:   Of Pitris, and, of those that judge, Yama the Judge I am;
88:   Of Daityas dread Prahlada; of what metes days and years,
89:   Time's self I am; of woodland-beasts-buffaloes, deers, and bears-
90:   The lordly-painted tiger; of birds the vast Garud,
91:   The whirlwind 'mid the winds; 'mid chiefs Rama with blood imbrued,
92:   Makar 'mid fishes of the sea, and Ganges 'mid the streams;
93:   Yea! First, and Last, and Centre of all which is or seems
94:   I am, Arjuna! Wisdom Supreme of what is wise,
95:   Words on the uttering lips I am, and eyesight of the eyes,
96:   And "A" of written characters, Dwandwa[FN#20] of knitted speech,
97:   And Endless Life, and boundless Love, whose power sustaineth each;
98:   And bitter Death which seizes all, and joyous sudden Birth,
99:   Which brings to light all beings that are to be on earth;
100:   And of the viewless virtues, Fame, Fortune, Song am I,
101:   And Memory, and Patience; and Craft, and Constancy:
102:   Of Vedic hymns the Vrihatsam, of metres Gayatri,
103:   Of months the Margasirsha, of all the seasons three
104:   The flower-wreathed Spring; in dicer's-play the conquering
105:   Double-Eight;
106:   The splendour of the splendid, and the greatness of the great,
107:   Victory I am, and Action! and the goodness of the good,
108:   And Vasudev of Vrishni's race, and of this Pandu brood
109:   Thyself!--Yea, my Arjuna! thyself; for thou art Mine!
110:   Of poets Usana, of saints Vyasa, sage divine;
111:   The policy of conquerors, the potency of kings,
112:   The great unbroken silence in learning's secret things;
113:   The lore of all the learned, the seed of all which springs.
114:   Living or lifeless, still or stirred, whatever beings be,
115:   None of them is in all the worlds, but it exists by Me!
116:   Nor tongue can tell, Arjuna! nor end of telling come
117:   Of these My boundless glories, whereof I teach thee some;
118:   For wheresoe'er is wondrous work, and majesty, and might,
119:   From Me hath all proceeded. Receive thou this aright!
120:   Yet how shouldst thou receive, O Prince! the vastness of this word?
121:   I, who am all, and made it all, abide its separate Lord!
122: 
123:   HERE ENDETH CHAPTER X. OF THE BHAGAVAD-GITA,
124:   Entitled "Vibhuti Yog,"
125:   Or "The Book of Religion by the Heavenly Perfections."

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.1 The Blessed Lord said Again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, listen to my supreme word which I will declare to thee who who art beloved, for thy welfare.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.7 He who rightly understands My manifested glory and My Creative Power, beyond doubt attains perfect peace.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.7 One who knows truly this majesty and yoga of Mine, he becomes imbued with unwavering Yoga. There is no doubt about this.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda

arnold.content:
Arjuna.
  Yes! Thou art Parabrahm! The High Abode!
  The Great Purification! Thou art God
  Eternal, All-creating, Holy, First,
  Without beginning! Lord of Lords and Gods!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.12 Arjuna said Thou art the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode (or the supreme light), the supreme purifier, eternal, divine Person, the primeval God, unborn andn omnipresent.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.12 Arjuna asked: Thou art the Supreme Spirit, the Eternal Home, the Holiest of the Holy, the Eternal Divine Self, the Primal God, the Unborn and the Omnipresent.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.12-10.13 Arjuna said You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages as also the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', still they are named separately because of their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself verily tell me (so).

असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥
records.iast:
āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
records.speaker: Arjuna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.13 All the sages have thus declared Thee, as also the divine sage Narada; so also Asita, Devala and Vyasa; and now Thou Thyself sayest so to me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.13 So have said the seers and the divine sage Narada; as well as Asita, Devala and Vyasa; and Thou Thyself also sayest it.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.12-10.13 Arjuna said You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages as also the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', still they are named separately because of their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself verily tell me (so).

records.sanskrit:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥
records.iast:
sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi keśava
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
records.speaker: Arjuna

arnold.content:
What Thou hast said now know I to be truth,
  O Kesava! that neither gods nor men
  Nor demons comprehend Thy mystery
  Made manifest, Divinest!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.14 I believe all this that Thou sayest to me to be true, O Krishna; verily, O blessed Lord! neither the gods nor the demons know Thy manifestation (origin).

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.14 I believe in what Thou hast said, my Lord! For neither the godly not the godless comprehend Thy manifestation.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.14 O Kesava, I accept to be true all this which You tell me. Certainly, O Lord, neither the gods nor the demons comprehend Your glory.

records.sanskrit:
स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥
records.iast:
svayamevātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama
bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate
records.speaker: Arjuna

arnold.content:
Thou Thyself
  Thyself alone dost know, Maker Supreme!
  Master of all the living! Lord of Gods!
  King of the Universe!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: Swami Sivananda did not comment on this sloka

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: Shri Purohit Swami did not comment on this sloka

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: Swami Gambirananda did not comment on this sloka

records.sanskrit:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ॥
records.iast:
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ
yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
records.speaker: Arjuna

arnold.content:
To Thee alone
  Belongs to tell the heavenly excellence
  Of those perfections wherewith Thou dost fill
  These worlds of Thine; Pervading, Immanent!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.16 Thou shouldst indeed tell, without reserve, of Thy divine glories by which Thou existest, pervading all these worlds. (None else can do so.)

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.16 Please tell me all about Thy glorious manifestations, by means of which Thou pervadest the world.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.16 Be pleased to speak in full of Your own manifestations which are indeed divine, through which manifestations You exist pervading these worlds.

records.sanskrit:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥
records.iast:
kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāṃ sadā paricintayan
keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo.asi bhagavanmayā
records.speaker: Arjuna

arnold.content:
How shall I learn, Supremest Mystery!
  To know Thee, though I muse continually?
  Under what form of Thine unnumbered forms
  Mayst Thou be grasped?

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text:
10.17 How shall I, ever meditating, know Thee, O Yogin? In what aspects or things, O blessed
Lord, art Thou to be thought of by me?

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.17 O Master! How shall I, by constant meditation, know Thee? My Lord! What are Thy various manifestations through which I am to mediate on Thee?

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.17 O Yogi, [Here yoga stands for the results of yoga, viz omniscience, omnipotence, etc.; one possessed of these is a yogi. (See Comm. on 10.7)] how shall I know You by remaining ever-engaged in meditation? And through what objects, O Lord, are You to be meditated on by me?

records.sanskrit:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥
records.iast:
vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me.amṛtam
records.speaker: Arjuna

arnold.content:
Ah! yet again recount,
  Clear and complete, Thy great appearances,
  The secrets of Thy Majesty and Might,
  Thou High Delight of Men! Never enough
  Can mine ears drink the Amrit[FN#18] of such words!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.18 Tell me again in detail, O Krishna, of Thy Yogic power and glory; for I am not satiated with what I have heard of Thy life-giving and nectar-like speech.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.18 Tell me again, I pray, about the fullness of Thy power and Thy glory; for I feel that I am never satisfied when I listen to Thy immortal words.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.18 O Janardana, narrate to me again [In addition to what has been said in the seventh and ninth chapters.] Your onw yoga and (divine) manifestations elaborately. For, while hearing (Your) nectar-like (words), there is no satiety in me.

records.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥
records.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ
prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Krishna.
  Hanta! So be it! Kuru Prince! I will to thee unfold
  Some portions of My Majesty, whose powers are manifold!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.19 The Blessed Lord said Very well! Now I will declare to thee My divine glories in their prominence, O Arjuna; there is no end to their detailed description.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.19 Lord Shri Krishna replied: So be it, My beloved fried! I will unfold to thee some of the chief aspects of My glory. Of its full extent there is no end.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.19 The Blessed Lord said O best of the Kurus, now, according to their importance, I shall described to you My onw glories, which are indeed divine. There is no end to my manifestations.

records.sanskrit:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
records.iast:
ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ
ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
I am the Spirit seated deep in every creature's heart;
  From Me they come; by Me they live; at My word they depart!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.20 I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle and also the end of all beings.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.20 O Arjuna! I am the Self, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning and the life, and I am the end of them all.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.20 O Gudakesa, I am the Self residing in the hearts of all beings, and I am the beginning and the middle as also the end of (all) beings.

records.sanskrit:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥
records.iast:
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān
marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.21 Among the (twelve) Adityas, I am Vishnu; among luminaries, the radiant sun; I am Marichi among the (seven or forty-nine) Maruts; among stars the moon am I.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.21 Of all the creative Powers I am the Creator, of luminaries the Sun; the Whirlwind among the winds, and the Moon among planets.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.21 Among the Adityas [viz Dhata, Mitra, aryama, Rudra, Varuna, Surya, Bhaga, Vivasvan, Pusa, Savita, Tvasta and Visnu.-Tr.] I am Visnu; among the luminaries, the radiant sun; among the (forty-nine) Maruts [The seven groups of Maruts are Avaha, Pravaha, Vivaha, Paravaha, Udvaha, Samvaha and parivaha.-Tr.] I am Marici; among the stars I am the moon.

records.sanskrit:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ॥
records.iast:
vedānāṃ sāmavedo.asmi devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ
indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.22 Among the Vedas I am the Sama-Veda; I am Vasava among the gods; among the senses I am the mind; and I am intelligence among living beings.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.22 Of the Vedas I am the Hymns, I am the Electric Force in the Powers of Nature; of the senses I am the Mind; and I am the Intelligence in all that lives.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.22 Among the Vedas I am Sama-veda; among the gods I am Indra. Among the organs I am the mind, and I am the intelligence in creatures.

records.sanskrit:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ॥
records.iast:
rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām
vasūnāṃ pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.23 And, among the Rudras I am Sankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, the Lord of wealth (Kubera); among the Vasus I am Pavaka (fire); and among the (seven) mountains I am the Meru.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.23 Among Forces of Vitality I am the life, I am Mammon to the heathen and the godless; I am the Energy in fire, earth, wind, sky, heaven, sun, moon and planets; and among mountains am the Mount Meru.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.23 Among the Rudras [Aja, Ekapada, Ahirbudhnya, Pinaki, Aparajita, Tryam-baka, Mahesvara, Vrsakapi, Sambhu, Harana and Isvara. Different Puranas give different lists of eleven names.-Tr,] I am Sankara, and among the Yaksas and goblins I am Kubera [God of wealth. Yaksas are a class of demigods who attend on him and guard his wealth.]. Among the Vasus [According to the V.P. they are: Apa, dhruva, Soma, Dharma, Anila, Anala (Fire), Pratyusa and Prabhasa. The Mbh. and the Bh. given a different list.-Tr.] I am Fire, and among the mountains I am Meru.

records.sanskrit:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥
records.iast:
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim
senānīnāmahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Vrihaspati
  Know Me 'mid planetary Powers; 'mid Warriors heavenly
  Skanda; of all the water-floods the Sea which drinketh each,

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text:
10.24 And, among the household priests (of kings), O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati; among the army generals I am Skana; among lakes I am the ocean.
'

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.24 Among the priests, know, O Arjuna, that I am the Apostle Brihaspati; of generals I am Skanda, the Commander-in-Chief, and of waters I am the Ocean.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.24 O son of Prtha, know me to be Brhaspati, the foremost among the priests of kings. Among comanders of armies I am Skanda; among large expanses of water I am the sea.

records.sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥
records.iast:
maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram
yajñānāṃ japayajño.asmi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
And Bhrigu of the holy Saints, and OM of sacred speech;
  Of prayers the prayer ye whisper;[FN#19] of hills Himala's snow,

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.25 Among the great sages I am Bhrigu; among words I am the one syllable (Om); among sacrifices I am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the immovable things I am the Himalayas.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.25 Of the great seers I am Bhrigu, of words I am Om, of offerings I am the silent prayer, among things immovable I am the Himalayas.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.25 Among the great sages I am Bhrgu; of words I am the single syllable (Om) [Om is the best because it is the name as well as the symbol of Brahman.]. Among rituals I am the ritual of Japa [Japa, muttering prayers-repeating passages from the Vedas, silently repeating names of deities, etc. Rituals often involve killing of animals. But Japa is free from such injury, and hence the best.] of the immovables, the Himalaya.

records.sanskrit:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥
records.iast:
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.26 Among all the trees ( I am) the Peepul; among the divine sages, I am Narada; among Gandharvas, Chitraratha; among the perfected, the sage Kapila.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.26 Of trees I am the sacred Fig-tree, of the Divine Seers Narada, of the heavenly singers I am Chitraratha, their Leader, and of sages I am Kapila.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.26 Among all trees (I am) the Asvatha (peepul), and Narada among the divine sages. Among the dandharvas [A class of demigods regarded as the musicians of gods.] (I am) Citraratha; among the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.

records.sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥
records.iast:
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam
airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.27 Know Me as Ucchaisravas born of nectar, among horses; among lordly elephants (I am) the Airavata; and, among men, the king.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.27 Know that among horses I am Pegasus, the heaven-born; among the lordly elephants I am the White one, and I am the Ruler among men.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.27 Among horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, born of nectar; Airavata among the lordly elephants; and among men, the Kind of men. [Uccaihsravas and Airavata are respectively the divine horse and elephant of Indra.]

records.sanskrit:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥
records.iast:
āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk
prajanaścāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.28 Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am the wish-fulfilling cow called Kamadhenu; I am the progenitor, the god of love; among serpents I am Vasuki.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.28 I am the Thunderbolt among weapons; of cows I am the Cow of Plenty, I am Passion in those who procreate, and I am the Cobra among serpents.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.28 Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am kamadhenu. I am Kandarpa, the Progenitor, and among serpents I am Vasuki.

records.sanskrit:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्।
पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥
records.iast:
anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham
pitṝṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.29 I am Ananta among the Nagas; I am Varuna among water-deities; Aryaman among the Manes I am; I am Yama among the governors.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.29 I am the King-python among snakes, I am the Aqueous Principle among those that live in water, I am the Father of fathers, and among rulers I am Death.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.29 Among snakes I am Ananta, and Varuna among gods of the waters. Among the manes I am Aryama, and among the maintainers of law and order I am Yama (King of death).

records.sanskrit:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
records.iast:
prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham
mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro.ahaṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Of Daityas dread Prahlada; of what metes days and years,
  Time's self I am; of woodland-beasts-buffaloes, deers, and bears-
  The lordly-painted tiger; of birds the vast Garud,

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.30 And, I am Prahlada among the demons, among the reckoners I am time; among beasts I am the lion, and Vainateya (Garuda) among birds.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.30 And I am the devotee Prahlad among the heathen; of Time I am the Eternal Present; I am the Lion among beasts and the Eagle among birds.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.30 Among demons I am Prahlada, and I am Time among reckoners of time. And among animals I am the loin, and among birds I am Garuda.

records.sanskrit:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ॥
records.iast:
pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
The whirlwind 'mid the winds; 'mid chiefs Rama with blood imbrued,
  Makar 'mid fishes of the sea, and Ganges 'mid the streams;

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.31 Among the purifiers (or the speeders) I am the wind; Rama among the warriors am I; among the fishes I am the shark; among the streams I am the Ganga.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.31 I am the Wind among purifiers, the King Rama among warriors; I am the Crocodile among the fishes, and I am the Ganges among rivers.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.31 Of the purifiers I am air; among the wielders of weapons I am Rama. Among fishes, too, I am the shark; I am Ganga among rivers.

records.sanskrit:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥
records.iast:
sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yea! First, and Last, and Centre of all which is or seems
  I am, Arjuna! Wisdom Supreme of what is wise,
  Words on the uttering lips I am, and eyesight of the eyes,

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.32 Among creations I am the beginning, the middle and also the end, O Arjuna; among the sciences I am the science of the Self; and I am the logic among controversialists.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.32 I am the Beginning, the Middle and the End in creation; among sciences, I am the science of Spirituality; I am the Discussion among disputants.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.32 O Arjuna, of creations I am the beginning and the end as also the middle, I am the knowledge of the Self among knowledge; of those who date I am vada.

records.sanskrit:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥
records.iast:
akṣarāṇāmakāro.asmi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca
ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
And "A" of written characters, Dwandwa[FN#20] of knitted speech,
  And Endless Life, and boundless Love, whose power sustaineth each;

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text:
10.33 Among the letters of the alphabets, the letter 'A' I am and the dual among the compounds. I am verily the inexhaustible or everlasting time; I am the dispenser (of the fruits of actions) having
faces in all directions.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.33 Of letters I am A; I am the copulative in compound words; I am Time inexhaustible; and I am the all-pervading Preserver.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.33 Of the letters I am the letter a, and of the group of compund words I am (the compound called) Dvandva. [Dvandva: A compound of two or more words which, if not compounded, would stand in the same case and be connected by the conjunction 'and'.-Tr.] I Mayself am the infinite time; I am the Dispenser with faces everywhere.

records.sanskrit:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
records.iast:
mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
And bitter Death which seizes all, and joyous sudden Birth,
  Which brings to light all beings that are to be on earth;
  And of the viewless virtues, Fame, Fortune, Song am I,
  And Memory, and Patience; and Craft, and Constancy:

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.34 And I am the all-devouring Death, and the prosperity of those who are to be prosperous; among the feminine alities (I am) fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, firmness and forgiveness.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.34 I am all-devouring Death; I am the Origin of all that shall happen; I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intellect, Constancy and Forgiveness.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.34 And I am Death, the destroyer of all; and the prosperity of those destined to be prosperous. Of the feminine [Narinam may mean 'of the feminine alities'. According to Sridhara Swami and S., the words fame etc. signify the goddesses of the respective alities. According to M.S. these seven goddesses are the wives of the god Dharma.-Tr.] (I am) fame, beauty, speech, memory, intelligence, fortitude and forbearance.

records.sanskrit:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥
records.iast:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo.ahamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.35 Among the hymns also I am the Brihatsaman; among metres Gayatri am I; among the montsh I am the Margasirsha; among the seasons (I am) the flowery season.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.35 Of hymns I am Brihatsama, of metres I am Garatri, among the months I am Margasheersha (December), and I am the Spring among seasons.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.35 I am also the Brhat-sama of the Sama (-mantras); of the metres, Gayatri. Of the months I am Marga-sirsa, and of the seasons, spring.

records.sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥
records.iast:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
jayo.asmi vyavasāyo.asmi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
in dicer's-play the conquering
  Double-Eight;
  The splendour of the splendid, and the greatness of the great,
  Victory I am, and Action! and the goodness of the good,

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.36 I am the gambling of the fraudulent; I am the splendour of the splendid; I am victory; I am determination (of those who are determined); I am the goodness of the good.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.36 I am the Gambling of the cheat and the Splendour of the splendid; I am Victory; I am Effort; and I am the Purity of the pure.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.36 Of the fraudulent I am the gambling; I am the irresistible ?nd of the mighty. I am excellene, I am effort, I am the sattva ality of those possessed of sattva.

records.sanskrit:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥
records.iast:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo.asmi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanañjayaḥ
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.37 Among the Vrishnis I am Vaasudeva; among the Pandavas I am Arjuna; among the sages I am Vyasa; among the Poets I am Usanas, the poet.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.37 I am Shri Krishna among the Vishnu-clan and Arjuna among the Pandavas; of the saints I am Vyasa, and I am Shukracharya among the sages.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.37 Of the vrsnis [The clan to which Sri krsna belonged, known otherwise as the Yadavas.] I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, Dhananjaya (Arjuna). And of the wise, I am Vyasa; of the omniscient, the omniscient Usanas.

records.sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥
records.iast:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.38 Of those who punish, I am the sceptre; among those who seek victory, I am statesmanship; and also among secrets, I am silence; knowledge among knowers I am.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.38 I am the Sceptre of rulers, the Strategy of the conquerors, the Silence of mystery, the Wisdom of the wise.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.38 Of the punishers I am the rod; I am the righteous policy of those who desire to coner. And of things secret, I am verily silence; I am knowledge of the men of knowledge৷৷

records.sanskrit:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
records.iast:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
the seed of all which springs.
  Living or lifeless, still or stirred, whatever beings be,
  None of them is in all the worlds, but it exists by Me!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.39 And whatever is the seed of all beings, that also am I, O Arjuna; there is no being, whether moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.39 I am the Seed of all being, O Arjuna! No creature moving or unmoving can live without Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.39 Moreover, O Arjuna, whatsoever is the seed of all beings, that I am. There is no thing moving or non-moving which can exist without Me.

records.sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
records.iast:
nānto.asti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Nor tongue can tell, Arjuna! nor end of telling come
  Of these My boundless glories, whereof I teach thee some;

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.40 There is no end to My divine gloreis, O Arjuna, but this is a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine glories.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.40 O Arjuna! The aspects of My divine life are endless. I have mentioned but a few by way of illustration.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.40 O destroyer of enemies, there is no limit to My divine manifestations. This description of (My) manifestations, however, has been stated by Me by way illustration.

records.sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥
records.iast:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā
tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃśasambhavam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
For wheresoe'er is wondrous work, and majesty, and might,
  From Me hath all proceeded. Receive thou this aright!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.41 Whatever being there is glorious, prosperous or powerful, that know thou to be a manifestation of a part of My splendour.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.41 Whatever is glorious, excellent, beautiful and mighty, be assured that it comes from a fragment of My splendour.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.41 Whatever object [All living beings] is verily endowed with majesty, possessed of prosperity, or is energetic, you know for certain each of them as having a part of My power as its source.

records.sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
records.iast:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yet how shouldst thou receive, O Prince! the vastness of this word?
  I, who am all, and made it all, abide its separate Lord!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 10.42 But, of what avail to thee is the knowledge of all these details, O Arjuna? I exist, supporting this whole world by one part of Myself.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 10.42 But what is the use of all these details to thee? O Arjuna! I sustain this universe with only small part of Myself."

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 10.42 Or, on the other hand, what is the need of your knowing this extensively, O Arjuna? I remain sustaning this whole creation in a special way with a part (of Myself).
